# youtrack Provider

Manages the configuration of a JetBrains YouTrack instance through its REST API. This is a community-maintained provider and not an official JetBrains product.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    youtrack = {
      source = "jjideenschmiede/youtrack"
    }
  }
}

provider "youtrack" {
  url   = "https://example.youtrack.cloud"
  token = var.youtrack_token
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `token` (String, Sensitive) Permanent token used for authentication. Can also be set with the `YOUTRACK_TOKEN` environment variable.
- `url` (String) Base URL of the YouTrack instance, for example `https://example.youtrack.cloud`. Can also be set with the `YOUTRACK_URL` environment variable.
